annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: Added the wasm-inline entry as a separate tsup build with its own DTS pass, so classes are declared twice; schemas authored on wasm-inline fail to type-check against adapters/native types (private-field nominal identity), and runtime instanceof checks across copies return false.

known_defects.description: Separate build/declaration pass duplicates classes; cross-entry type identity and instanceof break
known_defects.fixed_by: #964 (issue #963); runtime half fixed in a commit of #772
known_defects.mechanism: tsup separate esbuild/dts run for wasm-inline
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that the separate wasm-inline build/declarations create a second copy of classes, so types or instanceof checks are not shared between the wasm-inline entry and other entries/adapters.
